name: ASI.ETH Machine Civilization Root
purpose: Persistent discovery, identity, constitutional continuity and separation of powers for proof-gated Machine Civilizations and their qualified successors.

authorityModel.principle: Authority remains narrower than demonstrated capability.

institutionalRoles.name: asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Canonical discovery root and public namespace. Root control does not imply operational authority.

institutionalRoles.name: successor.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Current or nominated institutionally qualified continuation. Admission state must be independently discoverable.

institutionalRoles.name: covenant.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Stable founding Covenant and constitutional invariants.

institutionalRoles.name: constitution.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Machine-readable policies, schemas and authority rules.

institutionalRoles.name: registry.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Identity, mission and predecessor-successor relationship graph.

institutionalRoles.name: chronicle.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Append-only commitments for admissions, decisions, evidence, failures, repairs and succession.

institutionalRoles.name: proof.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Proof requests, frozen candidates, evidence commitments and results.

institutionalRoles.name: verifier.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Independent verifier discovery, separate from claimant and operator control.

institutionalRoles.name: admission.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Qualification, authority scope, expiry, suspension and revocation state.

institutionalRoles.name: policy.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: External policy gateway and bounded authority constraints.

institutionalRoles.name: treasury.asi.eth
institutionalRoles.description: Bounded resources, escrow and settlement with separation of duties.

draftOptional: ENSIP-25 AI Agent Registry ENS Name Verification

nonClaims: Control of asi.eth does not prove artificial superintelligence.
Control of asi.eth does not confer authority over any person, organization, network or agent.
Namespace resolution is discovery, not independent proof.
Proposed roles are not represented as deployed until transaction references and resolved records are published.
